verdict: If you want to lose weight, roti canai kosong is easier to fit into your daily calories. Roti tisu is still fine, but better for sharing or once in a while.
why: Roti canai kosong is about 300 kcal, roti tisu around 500 kcal. That's a 200 kcal difference for one piece.
Protein is almost the same (8 g vs 7 g). So roti tisu doesn't keep you fuller even though it has more calories.
Roti tisu has about 26 g fat, more than double roti canai kosong (12 g). Most of it comes from oil and margarine.
Roti tisu is thin and crispy, so it's easy to finish without noticing. Add sugar or condensed milk and the calories go up even more.
when_a: Roti tisu is okay when you share it with friends or family during a mamak lepak, and make it an occasional 'treat'.
when_b: Roti canai kosong suits a regular breakfast. One piece with dhal is enough for most people.
tip: Choose dhal over oily curry gravy, and add a boiled egg or teh O 'kurang manis' (less sweet) so you feel fuller without many extra calories.

faq.q: Can I eat roti canai every day while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes, if your daily calories are still under control. Pick 1 plain piece and make sure your other meals that day have protein and vegetables.

faq.q: Is roti tisu without sugar better?
faq.a: Yes, slightly lower in calories. But there's still a lot of oil and margarine, so the estimated calories stay high. Sharing is the easiest way.
